nodes.label: PR Version job (require unreleased version)
nodes.rationale: Fails when tag v<version> already exists; since every merge releases, each PR must bump the version.

nodes.norm_label: test wow64 inspection from the x64 build

nodes.label: Detect merged pull request job
nodes.rationale: Only merged pull requests into main (or manual runs on main) release; direct pushes do not create a release.

nodes.label: Release build job (exe + NSIS installer)
nodes.rationale: Verifies memx-ui.exe ProductVersion matches the Cargo version and exactly one NSIS installer exists before publishing.

nodes.label: SHA256SUMS.txt checksums
nodes.rationale: Binaries are unsigned, so checksums are published for download verification.

nodes.label: memx-ui.exe unified GUI/CLI executable
nodes.rationale: One executable opens the GUI with no arguments and runs CLI/TUI commands otherwise; it uses the GUI subsystem, so PowerShell must pipe to Out-Host to wait for output and exit code.

nodes.label: Type sources (symbol / rtti / user / heuristic)
nodes.rationale: Raw bytes carry no type, so every decoded value records where its type came from and a confidence level.

nodes.label: Administrator launch via UAC
nodes.rationale: Release builds request administrator rights to read services and other users' processes; debug builds run as-invoker so tests and development do not trigger UAC.

nodes.label: x64 and x86 builds
nodes.rationale: The x64 build reads 64-bit and WOW64 processes; the x86 build reads only 32-bit processes.

nodes.label: Versioning and releases (SemVer, Cargo.toml source of truth)
nodes.rationale: Cargo.toml is the single version source; tauri.conf.json intentionally has no version so Tauri embeds Cargo's version; every merged PR releases, so each PR bumps the version.
nodes.norm_label: versioning and releases (semver, cargo.toml source of truth)

nodes.label: Access and safety principles
nodes.rationale: Read-only by design; admin rights widen access but PP/PPL, kernel and VBS memory stay unreadable and memx reports the reason instead of bypassing; dumps and exports contain secrets.

nodes.label: CLI commands (ps, regions, read, inspect, symbol, search, dump, tui, startup)
nodes.norm_label: cli commands (ps, regions, read, inspect, symbol, search, dump, tui, startup)

nodes.label: Key constraints
nodes.rationale: Bytes have no type, the address space is huge, targets keep running and Windows limits access; so the design enumerates regions, reads lazily, shows provenance and confidence, and never bypasses protections.

nodes.label: Region Map Builder (RegionMap)
nodes.rationale: Sorted Vec with binary-search find(addr) because the pointer heuristic queries it heavily.

nodes.label: Region Labeler
nodes.rationale: ntdll functions are loaded dynamically; failures degrade to unlabeled rather than aborting.

nodes.label: Paged Memory Reader + Cache
nodes.rationale: Skips PAGE_NOACCESS/PAGE_GUARD because touching a guard page alters the target; per-page retry on ERROR_PARTIAL_COPY keeps readable bytes.

nodes.label: Type Inference Engine (heuristic)
nodes.rationale: Emits candidates in priority order (string, pointer, RTTI object, zero, float, integer, unknown), each tagged with confidence and source.

nodes.label: Tauri 2 desktop front-end (desktop-ui feature)
nodes.rationale: Embeds its assets so end users need neither Node.js nor Rust; never suspends targets.

nodes.label: IPC boundary (memory_request, startup_status, startup_set)
nodes.rationale: A strict tagged request enum with no shell, filesystem, write, injection or suspend operations minimizes GUI attack surface; remote origins get no capabilities.

nodes.label: Serialized inspection worker (bounded queue of 16)
nodes.rationale: A dedicated thread owns backend, handles, caches and DbgHelp providers so the Tauri async runtime never transfers raw Win32 handles or blocks the UI thread.

nodes.label: IPC wire format (hex-string addresses, null unreadable bytes)
nodes.rationale: 64-bit addresses are hex strings because JavaScript Numbers cannot hold them exactly; unreadable bytes are null so gaps are never shown as data.
nodes.norm_label: ipc wire format (hex-string addresses, null unreadable bytes)

nodes.label: Backend abstraction (ProcessBackend / Process traits)
nodes.rationale: Isolates OS calls behind a trait so Linux/macOS backends can be added later.

nodes.label: Windows backend (Toolhelp32, VirtualQueryEx, ReadProcessMemory, PSAPI, DbgHelp)
nodes.norm_label: windows backend (toolhelp32, virtualqueryex, readprocessmemory, psapi, dbghelp)

nodes.label: Point-in-time process dumps (PSS VA clone + MiniDumpWriteDump)
nodes.rationale: PSS clone gives capture-time private memory; PID reuse is rejected via creation times; no silent non-atomic live-dump fallback; existing files are never overwritten and partial files are removed.
nodes.norm_label: point-in-time process dumps (pss va clone + minidumpwritedump)

nodes.label: Sign-in startup via Task Scheduler (highest run level)
nodes.rationale: SID-scoped logon task avoids any service or driver; requires an elevated instance and a Program Files executable; not a silent privilege escalation.
nodes.norm_label: sign-in startup via task scheduler (highest run level)

nodes.label: Separate kernel/boot architecture (service broker + signed WDK driver, future)
nodes.rationale: Tauri is user mode and a Windows service is also user mode; boot-time diagnostics would need a separately signed driver and authenticated broker, so none is shipped.
nodes.norm_label: separate kernel/boot architecture (service broker + signed wdk driver, future)

nodes.label: SeDebugPrivilege
nodes.rationale: Attempted automatically when elevated as best effort; --debug-priv makes failure fatal; never bypasses PP/PPL.

nodes.label: WOW64 / 32-bit target support (IsWow64Process2)
nodes.rationale: Pointer width comes from the target; IsWow64Process2 failure is an error, not a silent 64-bit assumption.

nodes.label: memx Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Delivers the design in small, independently testable phases that each end with a working binary.

nodes.label: Risks and mitigations
nodes.rationale: Wrong heuristics mitigated by confidence/source and --as override; non-atomic reads by snapshot semantics and --suspend; missing PDBs by exports/RTTI; AV/EDR flags by read-only, signed, no-injection builds.
